    Required labeled sample size for desired PPI power

    n_required_PP.Rd

    Computes the minimum labeled sample size \(n\) needed to attain a target two-sided power when using prediction-powered inference, covering both the mean estimator and linear-regression (OLS) contrasts.

    n_required_PP(
  delta,
  N,
  alpha = 0.05,
  power = 0.8,
  type = c("mean", "ols", "custom"),
  var_f = NULL,
  var_res = NULL,
  V_u = NULL,
  V_l = NULL,
  c = NULL,
  var_unlabeled = NULL,
  var_labeled = NULL,
  warn_smallN = TRUE,
  smallN_threshold = 500,
  mode = c("error", "cap")
)

    Arguments

    delta

    Effect size \(\theta - \theta_0\) for the estimand of interest.

    N

    Unlabeled sample size.

    alpha

    Two-sided significance level.

    power

    Target power (\(1-\beta\)).

    type

    Either "mean" for the PP mean estimator, "ols" for a linear contrast in PP-OLS, or "custom" to supply pre-computed variance pieces (logistic regression in the future).

    var_f

    Variance of \(f(X)\). Required when type = "mean".

    var_res

    Variance of \(Y - f(X)\). Required when type = "mean".

    V_u, V_l

    Sandwich covariance matrices for the unlabeled and labeled PP-OLS pieces. Required when type = "ols".

    c

    Numeric vector specifying the linear contrast \(c^\top \beta\) for PP-OLS. Required when type = "ols".

    var_unlabeled, var_labeled

    Optional scalar variance components when type = "custom". These correspond to \(\mathrm{Var}_u\) and \(\mathrm{Var}_l\) so that the standard error is \(\sqrt{\mathrm{Var}_u/N + \mathrm{Var}_l/n}\).

    warn_smallN

    Logical; warn if N is below smallN_threshold.

    smallN_threshold

    Threshold for triggering the small-N warning.

    mode

    Either "error" (default) to throw when the required \(n\) exceeds N, or "cap" to return n = N with the achieved power attached as an attribute.

    Value

    Integer labeled sample size meeting the target power, possibly with an "achieved_power" attribute when mode = "cap".

    Examples

    # Mean estimator
n_required_PP(
  delta = 0.1, N = 5000, var_f = 0.2, var_res = 0.5,
  alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8, type = "mean"
)
#> [1] 406

# PP-OLS contrast
V_u <- diag(c(0.8, 0.6)); V_l <- diag(c(0.5, 0.7))
n_required_PP(
  delta = 0.15, N = 4000, V_u = V_u, V_l = V_l, c = c(1, 0),
  alpha = 0.05, power = 0.85, type = "ols"
)
#> [1] 217
